title: Siege of Kojinyama
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Kojinyama", at revision 1370742541, opens: "In the 1544 siege of Kojinyama, Takeda Shingen continued his invasion of Shinano Province's Ima Valley, seizing Kojinyama fortress from the Tozawa family." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1811771, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1544 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
